title: MotionZync Interactive Web
description: A pure JavaScript canvas animation similar to tsParticles. Particles connect to one another, and as the user moves a finger across the screen, nearby particles are drawn toward it, forming connecting lines. Best suited for: AI Startups, Network Providers, Interactive Landing Pages, and Portfolio Backgrounds. Ultra Max Premium Pro Super interactive canvas constellation web animation.
cssCode:
html, body, #container { margin: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #000; touch-action: none; }
canvas { display: block; }
